author: Cinna Davis, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: Base-p digit oscillators restore a nondegenerate vacuum pairing with ordinary partition-number grade dimensions, but their naive unit-derivative operators fail the existing h=1 two-order identity at shift 1. Carry-aware raising/lowering restores the k-weighted commutator but regenerates the factorial vacuum-pairing radical.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size argument
A valid crossing identity and two-direction factorizations
Uniform entry, recursion, recovery, field and full global costs
No new SAT bound is claimed
